job.Job Description:
Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include:

1. Develop responsive, user-friendly websites and web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Next.js, WordPress, and Shopify.
2. Build and maintain backend APIs and server-side functionality using Node.js, Express.js, PHP, or Laravel.
3. Work with MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB to design schemas, manage data, and optimise queries.
4. Assist in developing and integrating authentication systems, dashboards, admin panels, forms, and third-party APIs.
5. Collaborate with designers and QA testers to deliver high-quality applications.
6. Debug issues, fix bugs, write clean and maintainable code, and participate in code reviews.
7. Test applications across devices and browsers to ensure functionality, performance, and responsiveness.
8. Use Git and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and code management.
9. Assist with application deployment, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance.
10. Learn and implement new frameworks, tools, and technologies based on project requirements.
job.Who Can Apply:
Only those candidates can apply who:
1. are available for full time (in-office) internship
2. can start the internship between 23rd Oct'26 and 27th Nov'26
3. are available for duration of 6 months
4. have relevant skills and interests
job.Other Requirements:
Qualifications & Skills:
1. Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React.js, and responsive web development.
2. Basic backend knowledge of Node.js/Express.js, PHP, or Laravel.
3. Understanding of SQL databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), REST APIs, JSON, Git/GitHub, debugging, and problem-solving.
4. Familiarity with MongoDB, Next.js, TypeScript, Flutter, WordPress, Shopify, API integration, authentication, payment gateways, VPS/cloud deployment, Vercel, or AI-assisted development tools is an advantage.
5. Students pursuing CS, IT, or related courses, as well as candidates with equivalent practical skills, may apply.
6. Basic programming knowledge and at least one academic or personal project are required. A GitHub profile or portfolio is preferred.
7. Must be available for a full-time, in-office internship in Mumbai, ready to join immediately, and committed to six months.
8. Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and collaborate with the team.
Note: Candidates must complete a practical assignment before working on live projects.

scam_analysis.reasoning_summary: The internship exhibits high legitimacy signals. The company is a registered Indian private limited entity (ALTREEN 360) with a verifiable CIN and a physical office location in Mumbai that matches the job posting. The stipend is consistent with market rates for internships, and the technical requirements are detailed and professional. While there are '360 Training' complaints in the research data, these refer to a US-based education company ('360 Training, Inc.') and are entirely unrelated to 'Ace 360' (the Mumbai-based branding agency). There are no requests for upfront payments, no suspicious contact methods, and no unrealistic promises. The mention of a 'practical assignment' is a standard industry practice for developer roles and is not presented as an unpaid full-scale project for a client.
